purpose: Illustrative course-card imagery, not real institutions or partnerships

prompts.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: illustrative clinical programme card image for a restrained Attio Mono partnership-page carousel.
Style: premium, natural editorial medical-education photography; candid professional interaction, realistic skin and hands, uncluttered composition, soft window daylight, warm whites and neutral greys with very restrained clinical blue/sage details. Landscape 16:10 composition, main people and learning context in the central area so a modest card crop is safe.
Constraints: entirely fictional generic setting and adult people; no identifiable institution, signage, logos, badges with text, watermarks, readable screens or patient records. No text embedded in image. No dramatic lighting, glossy advertisement styling or real patients. Image is illustrative, not evidence of a provider relationship.
Scene: a senior clinician in a white coat discusses a clinical teaching case with two adult medical graduates in a bright hospital teaching room. They are listening and observing, gathered around a small table with a simple anatomical model and a closed notebook. Eye-level medium-wide photograph, calm attentive expressions.
